cities.name: Cogspire
cities.description: A neutral city of brass towers and ticking bridges. Every faith trades here.

cities.name: Santa Lucerna
cities.description: A walled city of bells and white stone, crowned by the Cathedral of the Lamp.

cities.name: Porticus
cities.description: Colonnades and libraries on a cold sea. The scholars here argue in whispers.

cities.name: Elderholt
cities.description: A town grown rather than built, among standing stones and oaks older than kings.

cities.name: Vinemere
cities.description: Lanterns, wine and masks. Every night is a feast, and every feast has a price.

cities.name: Ashenmouth
cities.description: A smoke-black town on the edge of the Pit. Its truce is old, and thin.

m_tech_1.title: Proof of Skill
m_tech_1.text: The guild only trades with duelists who can hold their own. Win two duels anywhere.

m_church_3.title: Medicine for the Hospice
m_church_3.text: The grove-keepers of Elderholt grow herbs the sick need. Carry a letter asking for them.

hc_1.title: Shadows on the Pilgrim Road
hc_1.text: Covenant cultists prey on pilgrims bound for the Cathedral of the Lamp. Defeat three of them.

hc_2.title: Escort to Porticus
hc_2.text: A party of pilgrims carries relics to the chapel of the scholars' city. See them safely to Porticus.

hc_3.title: The Last Templar
hc_3.text: Ser Gaudenz, last of the Templars, has shut himself in his chapel and duels all who come. Overcome him and bring him to confession.

hc_4.title: The Nameless Lich
hc_4.text: A lich has made his crypt in a ruined abbey to the south. Cleanse the holy ground.

hc_5.title: Close the Ninth Pit
hc_5.text: The herald of Belzareth stirs in the deepest pit. Go down with the Lamp and drive him back.

bc_1.title: Collect a Debt
bc_1.text: Some scholars borrowed against their souls and now hide behind their books. Defeat three of them.

bc_2.title: Break the Pilgrims
bc_2.text: The Church's knights guard the roads too well. Defeat three servants of the Church.

bc_3.title: Audience with the Lich
bc_3.text: The Nameless Lich grants nothing to the weak. Defeat him in his crypt and he will name his price.

bc_4.title: The Ninth Pit
bc_4.text: The herald of the pit tests every new servant. Survive the test.

ow_1.title: Iron in the Roots
ow_1.text: Constructs are cutting the old woods for the furnaces of Cogspire. Stop three of them.

ow_2.title: The Antlered One
ow_2.text: The great beast of the north wood has gone mad. Calm it the old way: by besting it.

ow_3.title: The Runaway Forge
ow_3.text: A foundry has broken loose and burns everything around it. Put out its fires.

ow_4.title: Blight from the South
ow_4.text: Ash from the Pit is poisoning the fields. Defeat three Covenant blighters.

rv_1.title: Hecklers at the Feast
rv_1.text: Sour philosophers keep lecturing the guests about moderation. Beat three of them at cards.

rv_2.title: A Song for Cogspire
rv_2.text: The guildsmen of Cogspire have never heard a good song. Take the show there.

rv_3.title: The Endless Banquet
rv_3.text: Duke Carnevale's feast has lasted a year. Somebody must win the final toast.

rv_4.title: Masks and Gears
rv_4.text: The guild says the carnival is a waste of good brass. Prove them wrong against three of their machines.

st_1.title: Field Study
st_1.text: Observe the excesses of Vinemere, and return unchanged.

st_2.title: Arguments in Vinemere
st_2.text: The revellers mock the Porch. Answer three of them in the only language they respect.

st_3.title: The Silent Sage
st_3.text: Our old master has stopped speaking and started duelling. Bring him back to reason.

st_4.title: Letters to the Cathedral
st_4.text: The Scholarch wishes to correspond with the Church about the soul. Carry his letters to Santa Lucerna.

tc_1.title: Letter to the Cathedral
tc_1.text: Carry the guild's accounts north to Santa Lucerna.

tc_2.title: Clearing the Woods
tc_2.text: The druids keep sabotaging the timber carts. Defeat three of them.

tc_3.title: The Runaway Forge
tc_3.text: Our best foundry has broken its governors. Shut it down before it melts the district.

tc_4.title: Audit of the Observatory
tc_4.text: The Silent Sage owes the guild for an orrery. Collect, by duel if necessary.
